description: Source code for managing cache rankings and linked list operations within a disk cache system, including transaction handling, crash simulation, and list integrity checks.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Handles crash-safe transactions for cache list modifications, ensuring crash recovery.

classes.name: Rankings
classes.description: Manages cache ranking lists, including insertion, removal, validation, and crash recovery.

methods.name: GenerateCrash
methods.description: Simulates crashes at specific points for testing crash recovery.

methods.name: UpdateTimes
methods.description: Updates last used and last modified timestamps of cache nodes.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the rankings system with backend and configuration.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the rankings state.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node into the rankings list with crash safety.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the rankings list with crash safety.

methods.name: UpdateRank
methods.description: Updates the position of a node in the rankings list.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next node in the list.

methods.name: GetPrev
methods.description: Retrieves the previous node in the list.

methods.name: CheckLinks
methods.description: Validates the integrity of links between nodes.

methods.name: CheckSingleLink
methods.description: Checks consistency of a single link between two nodes.

methods.name: CheckList
methods.description: Validates the entire list structure.

methods.name: SanityCheck
methods.description: Performs sanity checks on individual nodes.

methods.name: DataSanityCheck
methods.description: Checks data validity of nodes.

methods.name: SetContents
methods.description: Sets the contents address of a node.

methods.name: ReadHeads
methods.description: Reads head pointers from control data.

methods.name: ReadTails
methods.description: Reads tail pointers from control data.

methods.name: WriteHead
methods.description: Writes head pointer for a list.

methods.name: WriteTail
methods.description: Writes tail pointer for a list.

methods.name: GetRanking
methods.description: Loads and validates a ranking node.

methods.name: ConvertToLongLived
methods.description: Converts a node to a long-lived copy.

methods.name: CompleteTransaction
methods.description: Completes a crash recovery transaction.

methods.name: FinishInsert
methods.description: Finalizes an insert operation after crash recovery.

methods.name: RevertRemove
methods.description: Reverts a removal operation after crash recovery.

methods.name: UpdateIterators
methods.description: Updates cache iterators pointing to a node.

methods.name: UpdateIteratorsForRemoved
methods.description: Updates iterators after node removal.

methods.name: IncrementCounter
methods.description: Increments list size counters.

methods.name: DecrementCounter
methods.description: Decrements list size counters.
